[[Figueira da Foz]], Portugal | capacity = 9,000{{citation needed|date=October 2025}} | chairman = Aprígio Santos | manager = Carlos Neves | league = Division of Honour in the, [[Coimbra Football Association]] | position = | website = {{URL|https://www.naval1893.pt/o-clube/}} | pattern_la1 = _white_hoops | pattern_b1 = _white_hoops | pattern_ra1 = _white_hoops | leftarm1 = 00A86B | body1 = 00A86B | rightarm1 = 00A86B | shorts1 = FFFFFF | socks1 = 00A86B | pattern_la2 = _greenborder | pattern_b2 = _greenborder | pattern_ra2 = _greenborder | leftarm2 = FFFF00 | body2 = FFFF00 | rightarm2 = FFFF00 | shorts2 = 00A86B | socks2 = FFFF00 | current = }} '''Associação Naval 1º de Maio''' or '''Naval 1º Maio''', commonly known as '''Naval''', was a Portuguese [[Association football|football]] club based in [[Figueira da Foz]], [[Coimbra District]]. Founded on 1 May 1893, it last played in the Division of Honour in the [[Coimbra Football Association]], holding home games at the [[Estádio Municipal José Bento Pessoa]], with a capacity of 9,000 spectators. The club spent six seasons between 2005 and 2011 in the first division, the [[Primeira Liga]]. Naval was one of the main teams from the [[Centro Region, Portugal|Centro Region]], alongside [[Associação Académica de Coimbra – O.A.F.|Académica de Coimbra]], [[S.C. Beira-Mar|Beira-Mar]], [[U.D. Leiria|União de Leiria]] and [[União de Coimbra]]. The team was dissolved in 2017."}}
